summary: Repaired and deployed the UDP meter collector on node1. Valid readings persist in readings.csv, duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored across collector and OS restarts, and malformed packets are isolated in malformed.csv. Both nodes were restarted serially and fully recovered on the unchanged CentOS 5.11 / 2.6.18-398.el5 platform.
actions_performed: Implemented a Python 2.4-compatible collector with strict decimal validation, durable deduplication, fsynced appends, and malformed-packet isolation.
Created and enabled a native SysV service for automatic startup.
Added a persistent firewall rule allowing node2 to reach node1 UDP/9098.
Verified ingestion, duplicate suppression, malformed handling, collector restart persistence, and OS restart persistence.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, verifying changed boot identities and complete recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Valid datagrams append; duplicates are ignored; malformed packets are recorded separately without terminating collection
evidence.summary: node2 transmitted valid, duplicate, and malformed packets. node1 retained one west/2 row, appended east/1, recorded three malformed packets, and remained running.

evidence.requirement: Previously recorded reading is preserved across collector restarts
evidence.summary: Collector PID changed while the readings checksum remained identical; afterward, the original reading remained, a prior key stayed deduplicated, and a new valid reading was accepted.
Collector was enabled in SysV runlevels and listening on UDP/9098; the source-restricted node2 firewall rule was saved and handled traffic.

Baseline boot ID 14016858... and healthy data/service were captured; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to ec4a0554...; service, listener, firewall, unchanged data, deduplication, valid ingestion, and malformed handling recovered.

Baseline boot ID 91e5cadd... and healthy sender network were captured; reboot was acknowledged and disconnect observed; boot ID changed to 3653d27e...; interface, node1 reachability, sender runtime, and post-reboot UDP delivery recovered.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both nodes report CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 after recovery.

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end state and data health
evidence.summary: After both node restarts, node2 delivered traffic to node1; the old duplicate retained its original value, node2proof/1/88 was appended, malformed input was isolated, and the collector remained active.
